Spatial prediction
A 28 m span reaches the western half of I04. O03 blocks
the bridge-facing stance from the two district departures;
the crossers go south of its tip, then choose Fountain or
the north School porch. This is an occupied receiving room
with 3 m clear height, not a safe zone.
Follower / support
F0 cannot trade around the return immediately. F1 must
advance to (82,54,+4), where the ray to O passes south of
the return tip. The 5.55 m gap south of O03 permits
two-body movement and a retreat.
Opponent / retreat
O can hold the east departure or push the room; S can
pressure the north doorway. One defender may reposition
between them, but the return prevents the same fixed
bridge stance from seeing all three fronts. No peeker or
utility claim is made.
